title: Returned-Payment Record and Account Age: Share Returned on a Crestline Credit Card Returned Payment Fee
content:
On a Crestline Credit Card account, the share that Northgate's returned-fee courtesy credit applies to its credit basis has a starting point that depends on the account's returned-payment record and age, with months counted as whole calendar months up to today: when at least one returned payment fee besides the one being credited was posted fewer than 12 months before today (two or more returned payment fees in that time, the credited one included) and the account was opened fewer than 36 months before today, the share starts from 0.4 in place of 1.0; when such another fee exists and the account was opened 36 months or more before today, it starts from 0.55 in place of 1.0; otherwise it starts from 1.0.

| Returned payment fees posted fewer than 12 months before today (credited one included) | Account opened | Share starts from |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | fewer than 36 whole months ago | 0.4 (40 percent) |
| two or more | 36 whole months ago or more | 0.55 (55 percent) |
| fewer than two | any | 1.0 (100 percent) |

**Records read:** the returned payment fee entries on the card ledger and their posting dates; the account's open date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Account opened 35 whole months ago, a second returned payment fee 4 months ago: 0.4. Opened 36 whole months ago, same record: 0.55.
- The only other returned payment fee was posted 13 months ago: it is outside the 12 months; the share starts from 1.0.
